name: XST fee-on-transfer skim loop
summary: XST charged its transfer fee in a way that credited the Uniswap pair on every pair.skim(), so repeatedly skimming the pair to itself inflated the attacker's XST balance, which was then dumped for the pool's WETH.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
